events.title: Steam Next Fest is here! - Demo Patch #3
events.summary: Last patch before the Steam Next Fest! Nothing major added since we're more looking at improving what's already there rather than shaking up the game in major ways. That's why this patch focuses more on quality of life changes and new content plus improvements on what was already there. After this, you can expect one more patch planned for the release of the game on November 6. For those new to the game or coming back, I added the two previous major patches we released down below. events.title: Gear Up Einstein! – Demo Gameplay Broadcast
events.summary: Next Fest Gameplay Replay Wondering what Gear Up Einstein! looks like in action? We're running a gameplay replay on our store page for all of Steam Next Fest. This is a pre-recorded broadcast, not a live stream. Try it yourself The free demo is available now during Next Fest. Grab a friend, gear up, and see how far your team can go in this co-op strategy roguelite. Coming to Early Access – November 6, 2026 Add Gear Up Einstein! to your wishlist so you don't miss the launch! Wishlist on Steam

events.title: Crossroad Update - Demo Patch #2
events.summary: With this patch, we're bringing you the ability to choose your path and encounter random events through our new CROSSROAD feature. We also completely reworked the final invasion levels, changed the butterfly effects, created new agent traits, added achievements, and implemented quality of life features.
